description: Return checked finding counts for one peptide by outcome group, evidence class and direction, plus year, design and safety counts. Use this to inspect evidence coverage and gaps. Use search_findings instead for individual claims and source sentences, or compare_peptides for several peptides. Counts use administered findings only. The endogenous block counts measurements of the body's own peptide. Those measurements are not evidence about taking the peptide. Each finding has an evidence class: human, animal, laboratory or predicted. A count of 0 human findings means no checked human findings within the filters or outcome group. It does not mean that no human study exists.

peptide.description: Peptide name, alias, slug or ID. Examples: BPC-157, semaglutide, PEP-000001.
